title: Discovering Data Manifold Geometry through Geometric Properties
abstract: arXiv:2602.02611v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A prevailing paradigm in modern representation learning is the map-first approach, in which a representation map is learned from reconstruction, embedding, or task objectives. At the optimum, when the learned map accurately recovers a global coordinate chart, it should exhibit three structural properties whose geometric meaning can be illustrated through a face-editing example: Commutativity requires that changing pose and then expression gives the same result as applying them in the reverse order; Time Coherence requires that the same variation along one coordinate induces the same expression change across faces; Common-Reference requires that all faces are organized relative to a common reference face. However, small approximation errors in the learned map need not translate into small errors in these structural properties, and can therefore disrupt the global organization of the representation. translated_title: 通过几何性质发现数据流形几何
translated_abstract: 现代表示学习中的主流范式是“映射优先”方法，即通过重构、嵌入或任务目标来学习一个表示映射。在最优情况下，当学习到的映射能够准确恢复全局坐标图时，它应当展现三种结构性质，其几何意义可以通过人脸编辑的例子加以说明：交换性要求先改变姿态再改变表情，与以相反顺序应用这两种操作得到相同的结果；时间一致性要求沿某一坐标的相同变化在不同人脸之间引起相同的表情变化；公共参考要求所有人脸相对于一个公共参考人脸进行组织。然而，学习到的映射中的微小近似误差并不一定会转化为这些结构性质中的微小误差，因此可能会破坏表示的全局组织。基于这一观察，我们考虑……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出用交换性、时间一致性和公共参考这三种几何结构性质来刻画数据流形的全局几何，并指出学习映射中的微小近似误差可能破坏表示的全局组织。
